transcript: Is it a good plan to keep all my notes in one big file? Give me your honest opinion.
answer:
Honestly, no — it's a bad plan long-term.

One big file gets slow, hard to search, easy to lose things in, and one corruption/sync error can take everything out.

Better: many small notes organized by topic/project, with links.
